title: 빛바랜 너
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A clean electric guitar provides subtle arpeggiated textures in the background. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal performance is intimate with a slight breathy quality, utilizing a wide dynamic range. Reverb is applied to the vocals and piano to create a sense of space. The harmonic structure follows a diatonic progression in the key of C Major. No percussion or bass is present in this segment.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[sustained grand piano chords, clean electric guitar arpeggios]

[Verse 1]
[intimate baritone male vocals]
비오는 저녁이야
서랍을 열어서
먼지 묻은 사진 한 장 손끝에 닿아
네 얼굴이 뿌옇게 색이 바래 가
그때 입었던 옷도 무슨 색이었지
기억마저 바래 가

[Chorus]
[vocal intensity increases, piano plays more rhythmic chords]
폴라로이드 위의 시간이 멈춰 있을 줄 알았어
색이 사라져도
